title: Stage - Business Data Analyst (x/f/m) - janvier 2027
desc:
Nous recherchons un stagiaire Business Data Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe Affaires Publiques. Notre mission ? Mesurer l'impact des produits Doctolib sur le système de santé français en croisant analyse de données et enjeux de santé publique. Vous travaillerez sur des sujets concrets comme l'accès aux soins, les pratiques de téléconsultation ou la digitalisation des documents médicaux, au sein d'une équipe dynamique de cinq personnes basée entre Nantes et Levallois-Perret.

 


VOS MISSIONS

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

 - Collaborer avec les membres de l'équipe pour comprendre les besoins et identifier les bonnes données à aller chercher

 - Collecter, nettoyer et analyser des données provenant principalement de notre produit pour en tirer des informations clées

 - Utiliser des outils et des techniques d'analyse de données pour identifier des tendances, des modèles et des insights pertinents

 - Créer des tableaux de bord et des rapports pour industrialiser et communiquer les résultats de vos analyses de manière claire et concise

 - Proposer des recommandations basées sur les résultats obtenus 

 - Participer à la présentation interne et externe de vos analyses

Vous travaillerez dans cet environnement technologique :

 - Datawarehouse : AWS S3 / Redshift

 - Ad-Hoc / Exploration:  Metabase et DataGrip en SQL

 - BI / Reporting: Tableau

 


LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES POUR CE POSTE

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si :

 - Vous êtes étudiant(e) en cours de formation dans le domaine de l'informatique, des statistiques, des mathématiques appliquées ou tout autre domaine connexe

 - Vous avez une bonne maîtrise des outils d'analyse de données tel que SQL

 - Vous savez travailler de manière autonome et savez gérer efficacement les délais

 - Vous avez de fortes compétences analytiques et capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes

 - Vous avez de bonnes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale

 - Vous avez un intérêt pour la santé publique

 


NOTRE OFFRE

 - Un programme d’onboarding complet, avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation au sein de votre équipe (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

 - Une carte Swile et de nombreuses offres de restauration au sein de nos locaux 

 - Une offre de sport : un abonnement Urban Sports Club, des cours de sport gratuits dans les bureaux ou à distance

 - Le remboursement des titres de transport à 50%

 - De nombreux bureaux offrant des espaces de collaboration et de bien-être 

 - Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride

 


LE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

 - Un entretien Flore, Talent Partner (15 minutes) 

 - Un entretien opérationnel avec Brice, eHealth Product Strategist Manager (45 minutes)

 - La restitution d’un cas pratique avec Brice et un autre membre de son équipe (1 heure) 

 


DÉTAILS DU POSTE 

 - Stage conventionné à temps plein

 - Durée : 6 mois

 - Début souhaité : janvier 2027

 - Lieu de Travail : Levallois-Perret

 - Gratification : À définir selon niveau d’études

 
 

Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

Afin de garantir l'égalité des chances, nous vous invitons à exclure les informations personnelles (par exemple : photos, âge) de vos candidatures. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers, merci de nous en informer pour que nous puissions adapter le processus de recrutement. Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !

Toutes les informations fournies sont traitées par Doctolib pour la gestion des candidatures. Pour plus de détails sur le traitement des données, cliquez ici https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-FR. Veuillez contacter hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com pour toute question ou pour exercer vos droits.

title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
desc:
WHY THIS POSITION IS IMPORTANT

Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it.

The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot: automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible.

These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production.




HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor.

Every topic follows the same path:

 - Evaluation first: in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter.

 - A baseline in production: you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3.

 - Then go further: you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result.

You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results.




TOPICS FOR 2027

Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you.

 - Reading invoices and new types of documents with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

 - Knowing when the AI is right: calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions.

 - Evaluating accounting agents: an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring.

 - Learning from accountants' corrections: turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees.

 - Bank reconciliation: matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation.

 - An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets: from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production.

 - Data foundations for AI: evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own.
   
   


AI WILL BE PART OF HOW YOU WORK

You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Python and SQL, run experiments, write tests and debug.

We expect you to give agents the right context and to check their output. You own the result, not the agent.




OUR CULTURE

You will join a hands-on engineering culture, where two technical co-founders are still among the most active contributors to the codebase.

You will work with ML and AI engineers, data specialists, software engineers, product managers and accountants. You will have strong mentorship and a lot of ownership: freedom to test ideas, challenge existing approaches and build things from scratch, with an R&D mindset.

The goal is not a demo. It is something the team can trust, reuse and ship.




YOU'RE THE RIGHT CANDIDATE IF YOU

 - Are in the final year of a Master's degree or engineering school in machine learning, computer science, statistics or applied mathematics. Research internships of at least 4 months are also considered.

 - Have strong ML foundations and solid Python, and have already trained, fine-tuned or evaluated models in academic, personal or professional projects.

 - Care about evaluation: clean baselines, reproducible experiments and metrics that reflect the real problem.

 - Are comfortable with real-world data: SQL, analysis, messy and imbalanced datasets.

 - Already use AI ambitiously in your projects and can explain how you verify its output.

 - Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary team. No accounting knowledge is required, only curiosity.
   
   


PRACTICAL INFORMATION

 - Duration: 5 to 6 months (final-year internship).

 - Start date: March or April 2027.

 - Location: Paris office, at least 3 days per week on site, together with your tutor.

 - Supervision: a dedicated tutor from the ML & AI team.

 - Resources: GPUs, API access to frontier models, real data under GDPR-compliant conditions, and our existing evaluation infrastructure.

 - After the internship: an opportunity to join Pennylane full-time on a permanent contract.
   
   


HOW TO APPLY

Please send us:

 - Your CV.

 - Links to relevant projects: GitHub repositories, technical reports, notebooks or papers.

 - A few lines on your motivation and the topics that interest you most.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles 

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : dpo@pennylane.com.  dpo@pennylane.com 
Notre data policy https://www.pennylane.com/fr/vos-donnees-personnelles-recrutement

title: (Junior) Customer Service Complaints Agent - German Speaking (m/f/d)
desc:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

We are looking for a dedicated and competent professional to strengthen our team in the area of Solution Management EU, Customer Service. In this role, you will take on complaint handling, primarily for our German-speaking markets. Do you have a knack for de-escalation, work in a structured manner, and keep an overview even in challenging situations? If you want to drive complex cases forward in a solution-oriented manner and enjoy a constructive error culture, we look forward to receiving your application!

Your Responsibilities

• Complaint Management: You will handle customer complaints independently and on time. In doing so, you act in a solution-oriented and professional manner to ensure customer satisfaction even in difficult cases and a high-frequency environment.

• Root Cause Analysis & Optimization: You systematically analyze the reasons for complaints in order to identify operational weaknesses and initiate sustainable process improvements.

• Solution Orientation: You make well-founded decisions regarding goodwill arrangements within defined guidelines to achieve a fast and satisfactory solution for our customers.

• Quality Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant.

• Risk Assessment: You identify potential operational or legal risks at an early stage and support their minimization.

• Interface Management: You coordinate closely with internal departments (e.g., Product, Operations) to resolve complex issues quickly and in a customer-friendly manner.

Your Profile

• Completed training, ideally in banking or insurance, the legal field, or comparable areas.

• At least 1-2 years of experience in complaint management, customer service, or handling demanding customer inquiries – ideally in the financial services industry or a comparable regulatory environment.

• Strong understanding of de-escalation strategies as well as the ability to communicate complex issues in an understandable and solution-oriented manner.

• A strong ability to prioritize correctly even with high ticket volumes and to comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• A high sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Minimum C1 fluency (written and spoken) in German is required, along with good working proficiency in English (C1). Any additional language skills are a strong plus.

• Good IT skills (especially Google Workspace, Zendesk).

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

• Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

• A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.

• Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

• You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
